discovery: Restricted nearest-center bisectors on each hull triangle; all atoms are checked on the whole origin segment and outward-normal infinite ray. Candidate optimality is not assumed.
upper_proof: Complete positive-margin midpoint-subdivision ball cover of every hull face; origin remains free. Failed search or exhausted cover budget supplies no closure proof.
acceptance: Accept only a verified positive path at lower probe and a complete verified hull cover at upper probe. Report actual width and achieved ladder; a wider or unavailable result does not meet desired width. Exact transition and maximum bottleneck remain unavailable.
known_results: Existing reference endpoints known before this refinement; no held-out or algorithm-superiority claim.
